program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((legend (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first g))))
         (objs (filter (lambda (o) (all? (lambda (p) (> (first p) 0)) (obj-cells o))) (objects g 0))))
    (define (find-obj color) (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) color)) objs)))
    (define crops (map find-obj legend))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let loop ([remaining crops] [offset 0])
          (cond [(empty? remaining) 0]
                [(and (>= r 1) (>= c offset) (< c (+ offset (obj-w (first remaining)))))
                 (let* ((obj (first remaining)) (rr (+ (obj-r1 obj) (- r 1))) (cc (+ (obj-c1 obj) (- c offset))))
                   (if (and (< (- r 1) (obj-h obj)) (member? (list rr cc) (obj-cells obj))) (at g rr cc) 0))]
                [else (loop (rest remaining) (+ offset (obj-w (first remaining)) 1))]))))))
